description:
Hushfeed v0.53.0 targets global TikTok 47.0.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

Comment tools adds Compact comment header. It removes the comment count, sort and close buttons, plus the suggestion area and its empty space, so comments start at the top of the panel. The comment list and reply box remain available. Use Back or swipe down to close it. Headers with list-navigation tabs stay visible. The switch is off by default and needs a restart.

Validation: 1503 runtime tests passed locally, plus 255 patch tests. Both Android lint checks passed. The bundle carries 91 patches and all three nonempty DEX payloads. All 91 patches applied to TikTok 47.0.3 and retained 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures with no manifest changes. Older fixtures are compatibility checks; use 47.0.3 when patching.

The exact release-derived APK was installed on the S22 with the same signing key and unchanged first-install time. A controlled on/off comparison gave the comment list 214 more pixels without moving its bottom edge or the reply box. Back, downward-swipe dismissal, reopening and reply-box focus passed. The signed-in account was preserved. The S25 wasn't updated or tested for this feature because its signing key differs from the local test key.

The Morphe source repair from v0.52.0 is included. If you saw The remote metadata file is unavailable, refresh the Hushfeed source. You don't need to clear Manager data or change its signing key.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer. The downloadable .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
